mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Certified Copy) of the Taiwanese Investing Entity

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; therefore the mandatory and exclusive route is Consular Legalization (cross-strait legalization): (1) notarization by a Taiwan district court notary; (2) legalization by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Bureau of Consular Affairs; (3) authentication by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF); (4) verification by the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) in China; (5) final submission to the local SAMR office.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening must be conducted against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU and UK equivalent lists, China's own sanctions list maintained by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Taiwan's FSC AML and sanctions database. All natural persons owning 25% or more directly or indirectly, senior managing officers, and all signatories with authority over the WFOE's bank accounts must be screened as Politically Exposed Persons, including family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence is required for clients structuring payments through escrow or wire transfers under the immigration visa consultancy model; negative news open-source research and adverse media review are expected for at least a five-year look-back. Any hit triggers immediate escalation to the AML compliance officer and filing of a suspicious transaction report with PBOC and the local FIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: China SAMR National Enterprise Name Reservation and Registration Online Platform (Enterprise Name Autonomous Reservation System under the State Administration for Market Regulation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in Simplified Chinese characters, following the four-tier statutory structure: (1) administrative division, (2) distinctive trade name, (3) industry or operational characteristics, and (4) organizational form 'Limited Liability Company'. Pinyin transliteration of a foreign trade name is allowed only as a supplementary translation in the business license filing; the legal name of record remains the Chinese script. The trade name must not be identical or too similar to existing registrations and must contain at least two Chinese characters. English names may be separately recorded but do not form part of the statutory name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 5 business days of receiving a written rejection, the applicant may request administrative reconsideration from the immediately superior SAMR in accordance with the Administrative Reconsideration Law, or submit a corrected application through the same portal after addressing the rejection grounds. If the rejection is based on identical or confusing similarity with an existing registered name, the applicant may petition the issuing SAMR for discharge of the earlier name or provide consent from the holder. An administrative appeal complaint may be filed with the local government's legal affairs office within 60 days of the rejection notice, and a subsequent administrative lawsuit is available within 6 months if the reconsideration decision remains adverse. Practical guidance: pre-application screening on NECIPS and reserving two or three alternative trade names will reduce rejection risk.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a WFOE engaged in study-abroad placement and immigration visa consultancy, a virtual office or commercial mailbox is not operationally viable and will be rejected by Chinese tax authorities, local SAMR, and Chinese banks for account opening under AML/KYC because the industry requires a physical licensed premises for customer reception, contract execution, and regulatory inspection. Additionally, the PRC Social Insurance Law and the local education bureau's licensing criteria mandate a fixed business address with lease registration and actual personnel presence. Therefore, a physical office lease with at least a 12-month term and a rent invoice is strongly advised.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for inspection: (1) lease contract and rent invoices; (2) office signage matching registered name; (3) staff present during normal business hours; (4) fire safety and business license displayed; (5) employment contracts and social insurance records. Quantified risk: High, 75-85% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months by SAMR or the local tax bureau, and a near-certain 100% inspection upon applying for the study-abroad service license.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), Articles 1, 2, 98-110 (for limited company), 128-156; Foreign Investment Act (外國人投資條例), Articles 6-14; 施行細則 Articles 3-5
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commerce – Company Registration Division; prior approval from MOEA Investment Commission (Foreign Investment Commission)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Application (公司設立登記申請書) together with Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) and Foreign Investment Approval Letter
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) limited company. Declared capital must be deposited in a Taiwan bank account and a bank-issued certificate of deposit must accompany the incorporation filing; the capital may be denomicated in NTD or foreign currency and must equal the amount approved by the MOEA.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the sole shareholder hereby subscribes and accepts fully paid-up shares in the amount stated in the capital table, and the Chairman is authorised to issue share certificates. (2) That the registered office shall be established at the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation and maintained for all statutory notices. (3) That [Name] is appointed as Director/Legal Representative, [Name] as General Manager, and [Name] as Company Secretary, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute regulatory filings, and apply for industrial licenses. All actions taken by promoters prior to this resolution are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Pre-Appoval and Company Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Investment Commission (Foreign Investment Commission) and MOEA Department of Commerce – Company Name Reservation Portal (全國商工行政服務入口網)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit online application through the MOEA One-Stop Commerce Portal. Provide proposed Chinese company name with '有限公司' if the WFOE is a limited company, the exact business scope (ISIC 7810 – study abroad and immigration consulting), and the foreign investor’s identity document. Pay NT$2,500 (approximately USD 80) processing fee. The Commission issues a Foreign Investment Approval Letter and the Department reserves the approved name.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Application Form (投資申請書)
Proposed Company Name and Business Scope
Foreign Investor Passport / Corporate Registry Excerpt (translations certified)
Power of Attorney to the local applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or partially rejected due to business scope or investor due-diligence, file an amended application within 15 days; if final rejection is received, appeal to the Ministry of Economic Appeals Commission within 30 days of the decision date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Temporary Bank Account and Capital Deposit Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local commercial bank in Taiwan (e.g., CTBC, Cathay United, or any licensed foreign exchange bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate bank account in the pre-incorporated name, deposit the declared paid-up capital from the foreign shareholder’s overseas account. Obtain a bank capital deposit certificate stating the account name, amount, currency, and deposit date. This certificate must be notarised by the bank and is a mandatory attachment for incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the incoming remittance is rejected for compliance reasons, provide a source-of-funds statement and the original foreign approval, or adjust the capital amount with an amended investment application; re-deposit within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Corporation Registration Filing with MOEA Department of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce – Company Registration Division (economy.gov.tw)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the incorporation application electronically via the MOEA Company and Commerce One-Stop Portal. Upload Articles of Incorporation, capital certificate, foreign approval, name reservation, and identification of the director (legal representative). Pay company registration fee of NT$1,000 (approximately USD 35). The registry issues the Company Registration Certificate (公司執照).
required_dossiers: Director's (Legal Representative’s) Consent and ID copy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a supplementary notice (補正通知), provide the requested documents within 15 days. In case of substantive rejection, file a written re-application with clarifications or appeal within 30 days to the MOEA Administrative Appeals Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company’s sole shareholder and board of directors (acting by written resolution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or execute a written unanimous resolution) to adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office address, and appointment of Director, General Manager, and Company Secretary. Record the meeting minutes in accordance with Article 172 of the Company Act; have the minutes notarised if required for bank or immigration licensing purposes.
required_dossiers: Registered Office Address Proof (lease or certified address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resolution is challenged for procedural defect, reconvene a new meeting with proper notice, or use a written unanimous resolution; if officers unwilling to serve, replace them via a supplemental shareholder resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Number Registration and Business Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the MOF (local branch) and the Local Municipal Commercial Registration Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the company registration certificate, register for a Profit-Seeking Enterprise Entity Tax Identification Number (統一編號/Tax ID) at the National Taxation Bureau. Additionally, apply for uniform invoice issuance (發票核定) and register the corporate seal with the local commercial office. This completes the statutory formation for operational purposes.
required_dossiers: Director's ID and tax declaration forms
Lease agreement or proof of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Tax Bureau requests additional documents (e.g., business proof, premises inspection), remedy by submitting requested items within 7 days and arrange a site inspection if necessary.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Education (MOE) – International Education Department; National Immigration Agency (NIA) under the Ministry of the Interior; Fire Safety Branch of the Municipal Fire Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Study Abroad Service Agency License (教育部留學服務機構許可) and Immigration Consulting Business Registration Certificate (移民業務機構註冊證)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category 4 – office-based professional advisory services; no industrial installation or controlled source
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for (no manufacturing discharge). The office must comply with the Indoor Air Quality Management Act (indoor PM2.5 and VOC within general commercial limits) and municipal commercial waste segregation rules; no wastewater discharge or VOC abatement thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety compliance per the Fire Services Act through annual inspection of extinguishers and emergency exits; structural occupancy certificate (or leasehold certification of building safety) for the registered office; occupational safety clearance confirming compliance with the Occupational Safety and Health Act for indoor workstations, including ergonomic and electrical safety inspections.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局), official portal https://www.chinatax.gov.cn, e-tax filing platform https://tpass.chinatax.gov.cn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Within 30 days of obtaining the business license, the WFOE must register with the local State Taxation Administration office via the e-tax platform, obtaining the Unified Social Credit Identifier (USCI) which serves as the statutory TIN/VAT ID. Required filings include articles of association, domicile proof (lease or ownership certificate), bank account information, legal representative and financial officer identification, and de facto office photographs. Post-registration, the taxpayer must activate VAT general taxpayer or small-scale status and apply for e-invoice quota through the e-tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (PRC resident enterprise; taxed on worldwide income at 25% corporate income tax; no pass-through treatment)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; PRC law does not provide check-the-box entity classification elections. A foreign-invested enterprise is always treated as a resident enterprise. The only election available is VAT taxpayer status: small-scale taxpayer (3% levy, simplified method) versus general taxpayer (6%/9%/13% rates with input credit), based on annual taxable turnover; no hybrid mismatch elections are available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.territorial_note: Although the composite key lists jurisdiction_id 'TW', the entity is a China WFOE organized as a PRC legal person. Taiwan is a separate customs and tax territory for cross-border VAT and export zero-rating purposes; therefore, supplies to Taiwan clients are treated as exports for PRC indirect tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (增值税) under the PRC VAT system, applicable to all taxable services and goods supplied by a Chinese WFOE
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Basic VAT registration is mandatory upon incorporation without turnover threshold; the mandatory general taxpayer threshold is annual taxable turnover exceeding RMB 5,000,000. Small-scale taxpayer status applies up to RMB 5,000,000 annual turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates fully digitalized e-invoicing (数电票) with real-time synchronization to the State Taxation Administration's consolidated e-invoice platform. General taxpayers must issue all invoices digitally through the e-tax portal; no physical fiscal stamping or manual clearance is required except for specific industries under approved pilots. Enterprise ERP integration through official API is available and standard practice for WFOEs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may apply 0% VAT to cross-border services exported to Taiwan if (1) it is a VAT general taxpayer, (2) the recipient is an overseas (Taiwan) enterprise or individual, (3) the service—including international student placement, study-abroad consulting, and immigration visa advisory—is supplied entirely for overseas consumption, and (4) the service falls within the 'advisory services' category listed in CaiShui [2016] No. 36 Annex 4. The tax authority requires that the service contract clearly states the overseas recipient, that payment is received from abroad, and that evidence of the service being consumed outside China (e.g., enrollment confirmation, visa grant notice, immigration application record) is retained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Cross-border service contract or agreement between the Chinese WFOE and the Taiwan-side client
VAT ordinary invoice or special invoice issued for the zero-rated exported service
Inbound foreign exchange settlement receipt (国际收支涉外收入申报单) or cross-border RMB payment voucher from the Taiwan client
Overseas consumption certificate: enrolment confirmation, study/immigration visa approval record, or formal service delivery report proving the service is consumed outside China
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger retrospective clawback of VAT refunds within 10 years, plus late payment surcharge at 0.05% per day, a fine of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax under the PRC Tax Administration Law, and criminal tax evasion liability if the evaded amount exceeds RMB 50,000 or the entity has prior tax violations. Tax authorities will also examine the authenticity of the overseas consumption evidence and may re-characterize the services as taxable domestic consultancy if the service is partially performed in mainland China.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May to 31 May following the relevant fiscal year; extension may apply where legally available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger a surcharge generally calculated by reference to tax payable, additional assessment, interest, and penalties. Taiwan has no automatic annual-franchise strike-off rule for late income-tax filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual company information and beneficial ownership confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within 15 days after the annual shareholders' meeting or, where applicable, within the statutory period following the end of the fiscal year; updates to reportable information must be filed within the prescribed change-reporting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to report or inaccurate reporting may result in fines generally ranging from approximately USD 1,550 to USD 15,500 per violation, with repeated fines and possible adverse company-registration measures. No fixed annual-return strike-off deadline applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting and approval of financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders; financial statements retained for inspection and regulatory purposes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinarily within six months after the end of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting or approve accounts may expose responsible persons to Company Act penalties and shareholder claims. It does not itself create an automatic annual franchise strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business tax reconciliation and transaction-record review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Taiwan business tax is generally filed bimonthly rather than through one annual franchise return; annual records must support the corporate income tax filing and tax audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate VAT filings may result in additional tax, interest, fines, and denial or adjustment of input-tax credits. No automatic annual strike-off rule applies.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit and certification is generally required for public companies and for private companies meeting applicable statutory thresholds, commonly including paid-in capital of at least NT$30 million, annual net operating revenue of at least NT$100 million, or at least 100 employees. Separate tax-audit requirements may apply under Ministry of Finance rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards, substantially converged with IFRS, subject to entity-size, public-company, and applicable SME accounting requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must maintain current information on directors, managers, significant shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners and make the required annual or post-shareholders-meeting confirmation with the Ministry of Economic Affairs. Share transfers and changes affecting reportable ownership must be recorded in the Register of Shareholders and reported within the applicable statutory period. The filing obligation is not limited to transfers occurring during the year.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Accounting books, vouchers, and approved financial statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 370-1,850 annually, depending on location, mail handling, nominee services, and compliance scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 2,500-9,400 for a qualifying private company; higher for regulated, cross-border, high-volume, or complex operations
